```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown

from html import escape
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit
from IPython.display import display, HTML


# ==========================================================
# LOAD CONTENT
# ==========================================================

with open("../../content/totaltool-background.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

navigation = data.get("navigation", {})
intro = data.get("intro", {})
sections = data.get("sections", [])
timeline = data.get("timeline", {})
resources = data.get("resources", {})
contact = data.get("contact", {})


# ==========================================================
# HELPERS
# ==========================================================

def safe(value):
    return escape(
        str(value if value is not None else ""),
        quote=True
    )


def md(value):
    """Render CMS-managed Markdown text."""
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )


def page_url(value):
    """Convert Quarto .qmd links to rendered .html links."""
    parts = urlsplit(str(value or ""))

    if parts.path.endswith(".qmd"):
        parts = parts._replace(
            path=parts.path[:-4] + ".html"
        )

    return urlunsplit(parts)


def render_paragraphs(items):
    """Render all paragraphs without changing their content."""
    return "".join(
        md(item if isinstance(item, str) else item.get("text", ""))
        for item in (items or [])
    )


def get_section(title):
    """Find an existing YAML section by its title."""
    for section in sections:
        if section.get("title") == title:
            return section

    return {}


def render_image(section):
    image = section.get("image") or {}

    if not image.get("path"):
        return ""

    return f"""
    <figure class="cw-totaltool-bg-figure">
      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-image-frame">
        <img
          src="{safe(image.get('path'))}"
          alt="{safe(image.get('alt'))}"
          loading="lazy"
        >
      </div>
      <figcaption>
        {safe(image.get('caption'))}
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
    """


def section_heading(kicker, title):
    return f"""
    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-section-heading">
      <span class="cw-totaltool-bg-kicker">
        {safe(kicker)}
      </span>
      <h2>{safe(title)}</h2>
    </div>
    """


def render_resources(items):
    result = ""

    for item in items or []:

        if item.get("links"):
            grouped = " | ".join(
                f'<a href="{safe(link.get("url"))}" '
                f'target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">'
                f'{safe(link.get("label"))}</a>'
                for link in item["links"]
            )

            result += f"""
            <li>
              {safe(item.get('prefix'))}
              {grouped}
              {safe(item.get('suffix'))}
            </li>
            """

        else:
            result += f"""
            <li>
              <a href="{safe(item.get('url'))}"
                 target="_blank"
                 rel="noopener noreferrer">
                {safe(item.get('label'))}
              </a>
              {safe(item.get('description'))}
            </li>
            """

    return f"""
    <ul class="cw-totaltool-bg-resource-list">
      {result}
    </ul>
    """


# ==========================================================
# NAVIGATION
# ==========================================================

nav_links = ""

for link in navigation.get("links", []):
    target = page_url(link.get("url"))
    active = target == "totaltool-background.html"

    nav_links += f"""
    <a
      class="cw-totaltool-bg-tab{' is-active' if active else ''}"
      href="{safe(target)}"
      {'aria-current="page"' if active else ''}
    >
      {safe(link.get('label'))}
    </a>
    """


# ==========================================================
# EXISTING CONTENT SECTIONS
# ==========================================================

life = get_section("Life History")

strandings = get_section(
    "U.S. West Coast Strandings and Fisheries Bycatch"
)

status = get_section("Endangered Species Status")

fishery = get_section("California Drift Gillnet Fishery")



# ==========================================================
# REGULATORY TIMELINE
# ==========================================================

timeline_items = ""

for item in timeline.get("items", []):

    timeline_items += f"""
    <article class="cw-totaltool-bg-timeline-item">

      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-timeline-marker"
           aria-hidden="true"></div>

      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-timeline-content">

        <span class="cw-totaltool-bg-timeline-year">
          {safe(item.get('year'))}
        </span>

        <h3>{safe(item.get('title'))}</h3>

        <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-timeline-description">
          {md(item.get('description'))}
        </div>

      </div>

    </article>
    """


timeline_html = ""

if timeline_items:
    timeline_html = f"""
    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-timeline">

      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-timeline-list">
        {timeline_items}
      </div>

    </div>
    """


# ==========================================================
# CONTACT FORM
# ==========================================================

form_fields = ""

allowed_types = {"text", "email", "tel"}

for field in contact.get("fields", []):

    field_type = str(field.get("type", "text"))

    required = "required" if field.get("required") else ""
    marker = " *" if field.get("required") else ""

    if field_type == "textarea":

        control = f"""
        <textarea
          name="{safe(field.get('name'))}"
          rows="6"
          placeholder="{safe(field.get('placeholder'))}"
          {required}
        ></textarea>
        """

    else:

        if field_type not in allowed_types:
            field_type = "text"

        control = f"""
        <input
          type="{safe(field_type)}"
          name="{safe(field.get('name'))}"
          placeholder="{safe(field.get('placeholder'))}"
          {required}
        >
        """

    form_fields += f"""
    <label class="cw-totaltool-bg-field">

      <span>
        {safe(field.get('label'))}{marker}
      </span>

      {control}

    </label>
    """


# ==========================================================
# PAGE HTML
# ==========================================================

html = f"""
<div class="cw-totaltool-bg">


  <!-- ====================================================
       PROJECT NAVIGATION
       ==================================================== -->

  <header class="cw-totaltool-bg-topbar">

    <a class="cw-totaltool-bg-brand"
       href="totaltool.html">

      <span class="cw-totaltool-bg-brand-name">
        {safe(navigation.get('brand', 'TOTAL'))}
      </span>

      <span class="cw-totaltool-bg-brand-subtitle">
        {safe(navigation.get('brand_subtitle'))}
      </span>

    </a>

    <nav class="cw-totaltool-bg-tabs"
         aria-label="TOTAL navigation">
      {nav_links}
    </nav>

  </header>


  <!-- ====================================================
       INTRODUCTION
       ==================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-bg-intro">

    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-intro-inner">

      <span class="cw-totaltool-bg-eyebrow">
        {safe(intro.get('eyebrow'))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(intro.get('title'))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(intro.get('subtitle'))}</p>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- ====================================================
       LIFE HISTORY
       ==================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-bg-section">

    {section_heading("LOGGERHEAD SEA TURTLES", life.get("title"))}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-feature-grid">

      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-feature-image">
        {render_image(life)}
      </div>

      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-feature-text">
        {render_paragraphs(life.get('paragraphs'))}
      </div>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- ====================================================
       STRANDINGS AND FISHERIES BYCATCH
       ==================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-bg-section">

    {section_heading(
        "FISHERIES INTERACTIONS",
        strandings.get("title")
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-reading">
      {render_paragraphs(strandings.get('paragraphs'))}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- ====================================================
       ENDANGERED SPECIES STATUS
       ==================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-bg-section">

    {section_heading(
        "SPECIES CONSERVATION",
        status.get("title")
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-highlight">
      {render_paragraphs(status.get('paragraphs'))}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- ====================================================
       CALIFORNIA DRIFT GILLNET FISHERY
       ==================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-bg-section">

    {section_heading(
        "COMMERCIAL FISHERIES",
        fishery.get("title")
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-feature-grid is-reversed">

      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-feature-text">
        {render_paragraphs(fishery.get('paragraphs'))}
      </div>

      <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-feature-image">
        {render_image(fishery)}
      </div>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- ====================================================
      REGULATORY HISTORY
      ==================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-bg-section cw-totaltool-bg-regulatory">

    {section_heading(
        "CONSERVATION MANAGEMENT",
        timeline.get("title", "Regulatory History")
    )}

    <!-- Complete regulatory history organized chronologically -->
    {timeline_html}

  </section>



  <!-- ====================================================
       RESOURCES AND CONTACT
       ==================================================== -->

  <section class="cw-totaltool-bg-resources">

    {section_heading(
        "SUPPORTING INFORMATION",
        resources.get("heading", "Resources & Contact")
    )}

    <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-accordion">

      <details class="cw-totaltool-bg-details">

        <summary>
          {safe(resources.get('title', 'Additional Information'))}
        </summary>

        <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-details-body">
          {render_resources(resources.get('links'))}
        </div>

      </details>


      <details class="cw-totaltool-bg-details">

        <summary>
          {safe(contact.get('title', 'Feedback / Contact Us'))}
        </summary>

        <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-details-body">

          <p class="cw-totaltool-bg-form-note">
            {safe(contact.get('notice'))}
          </p>

          <form class="cw-totaltool-bg-form">

            <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-form-grid">
              {form_fields}
            </div>

            <div class="cw-totaltool-bg-form-actions">

              <button
                type="submit"
                class="cw-totaltool-bg-btn"
                disabled
              >
                {safe(contact.get('submit_label', 'Submit Comments'))}
              </button>

              <button
                type="reset"
                class="cw-totaltool-bg-btn secondary"
              >
                {safe(contact.get('reset_label', 'Clear Form'))}
              </button>

            </div>

          </form>

        </div>

      </details>

    </div>

  </section>


</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
